description_en: This operation assigns the team administrator role to a user
description_zh: 当前支持将用户设置为团队管理员角色
kebab_example: aliyun pds assign-role --identity identity_id=16435bdf934248b788b7b3771ee9a3dw identity_type=IT_User --role-id SystemGroupAdmin --manage-resource-type RT_Group --manage-resource-id 105000b82 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssignRole

fields.help_en: The ID of the user or the group
fields.name: identity_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the identity. Valid values:

IT_User
IT_Group
fields.help_zh:
对象类型
IT_User：表示用户类型
IT_Group：表示群组类型
fields.name: identity_type

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the user
parameters.help_zh: 唯一身份标识，当前仅支持设置某个用户作为团队管理员
parameters.name: identity

parameters.help_en: The resource ID to manage. Currently, only a group ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 管理的资源ID，当前仅支持填Group ID
parameters.name: manage_resource_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type to manage. Currently, only `RT_Group` (group) is supported
parameters.help_zh: 管理的资源类型，当前仅支持：RT_Group（团队）
parameters.name: manage_resource_type

parameters.help_en: The role ID to assign to the user. Currently, only `SystemGroupAdmin` (team administrator) is supported
parameters.help_zh: 给用户分配的角色ID，当前仅支持填：SystemGroupAdmin（团队管理员）
parameters.name: role_id
